data.short_meaning: Strong in counsel, famous in battle
data.long_meaning: Ermentrude is a Germanic name derived from the elements erm (strong) and trud (counsel). The name means 'strong in counsel' or 'famous in battle'. Ermentrude was a popular name among the Franks and the Merovingians, and was borne by several notable women in medieval Europe. The name Ermentrude carries the meaning “Strong in counsel, famous in battle” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Ermentrude usually hope their child will grow to embody strong in counsel, famous in battle and live with faith, good character and purpose.
